subject.title: MissingAgentHarnessError race: non-atomic harness registry clear+restore during plugin cache cycle

question: Which harness ownership contract should empty plugin-scope and zero-plugin gateway reloads enforce before this issue can be fixed?
rationale: The direct candidate patch changes plugin runtime lifecycle semantics by restoring every previous harness, while repository policy treats plugin disablement, provider routing, and fallback behavior as compatibility- and security-sensitive.

options.title: Preserve only approved always-on harnesses
options.body: Keep core or bundled provider harnesses available across empty reloads while clearing disabled or out-of-scope plugin-owned harnesses.

options.title: Restore every prior harness
options.body: Adopt broad snapshot/restore semantics and explicitly accept that plugin-owned harnesses can survive an empty active plugin registry.

options.title: Keep clear-on-empty semantics
options.body: Leave empty reloads fail-closed and route the user problem through doctor/config warnings or caller retries instead.

recommendation.title: Preserve only approved always-on harnesses
recommendation.body: Keep core or bundled provider harnesses available across empty reloads while clearing disabled or out-of-scope plugin-owned harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the strongest available history owner for the harness registry and lifecycle contract touched by the decision.
